items.reason: A milder 2.5% wash is a gentler place to start for jaw-area breakouts, and you can step up to the 5% later if your skin stays comfortable.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports your skin's comfort and moisture while the wash settles in.
A mineral SPF 50 protects skin each morning and helps keep the look of post-breakout marks from deepening.

response.routine_note: Start with the wash once a day in the evening, rinse well, then moisturize, and wear the SPF every morning. If jaw breakouts feel painful, keep coming back or leave lasting marks, a dermatologist is the best next step.
